messages.subject: Cygnet House, Tabard Street SE1 - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to catch up yesterday. As discussed, we'd like Whitfield Carter to act on our acquisition of Cygnet House, 8 Tabard Street SE1. Heads have been broadly agreed with the seller (Ravenscroft Estates) at £21.75m for the freehold, subject to contract. Their agents are pushing for exchange within five weeks.

Can you send across your engagement letter and let me know the team. We'll be buying in Marchwood's own name rather than an SPV this time.

Thanks
Daniel

messages.subject: RE: Cygnet House, Tabard Street SE1 - instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Delighted to act. Our engagement letter is attached - if you can sign and return the copy with ID for the signatories we'll get going straight away. James Osei (copied) will have day-to-day conduct, with Elena Marchetti assisting and me supervising.

We'll request the contract package and title from Pemberton Rowe today and start the searches. On a £21.75m TOGC the headline numbers to keep in mind are SDLT of £1,077,000 and a 10% deposit of £2,175,000 on exchange.

Best
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
